findings.evidence: At 375 the page renders 577px wide: the nav keeps all four items in one row ('START FREE' runs to x≈445, past the viewport), and the hero keeps its two-column grid, so the h1 wraps to one word per line in a ~200px column and the metric labels wrap to 'TRIAL / → / PAID'. Sweep reported the logo row as the widest culprit; nav and hero grid also fail.
findings.before: .hero-grid two columns and inline nav at every width
findings.after: @media (max-width: 48rem) { .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr } .nav-links { display: none } } plus a Menu button; .logos-row { flex-wrap: wrap }
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow: no two-direction scrolling at 320 CSS px.

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: a.cta-text 'Book a demo →' has href '#pricing'. It does not book anything; it scrolls to pricing.
findings.after: Point it at a booking page, or relabel 'See pricing'.

findings.evidence: Accessible names include the decorative numbering and dash: read as 'zero one em dash Features'. Visible text is uppercased by CSS, so the name is mixed case, which is fine, but the number is noise.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose and 2.5.3 Label in Name (keep 'Features' as the spoken name).

findings.evidence: Each customer name is a span with an unlabelled inline svg glyph (▲, ◠, ≡, ○, ›) and no aria-hidden; they are announced as unnamed images or skipped inconsistently.

The quote is a blockquote but the attribution 'Sarah Chen — Founder, Stitchboard' sits outside it in a separate styled line with no figure/figcaption or cite, so the speaker is not programmatically tied to the quote.
header, nav and footer exist but no main (sweep) and no skip link: focus.json starts at '01 — FEATURES' and runs 6 controls before the content.

strengths: Focus order (14 stops in focus.json) follows the visual order and no stop is covered by sticky chrome.
Primary CTAs are real buttons and links with visible text names.
not_investigated: Verified the sweep's #e34a2b contrast hits on tile 1440-00 (red kicker and white-on-red button text at 12px both look light); no disputes
button behaviour: 'Start free' buttons have no form or href; whether a script handles them was not tested
